parsed.post: Kept the improvement from 0.997581 to 0.995485 by keeping MATRIX_LR=0.03 and decreasing WARMUP_RATIO from 0.1 to 0.05. It seems the previous 0.1 warmup was too long, potentially slowing convergence within the 5-minute window. Final round: probing WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 -> 0.0 (no warmup) to see if maximum training time on high LR helps.
parsed.description: Testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.0 to maximize the effective learning rate throughout the entire 5-minute budget, as the 0.1 warmup may have been too conservative.
